messages:
tara: Heads-up: released community-eval-runner v0.3.0 — local harness, policy-plugin hooks, and a small config rename. Release notes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/community-eval-runner/releases/tag/v0.3.0 :tada:
open-source-bot: Release published: community-eval-runner v0.3.0 by @tara — https://github.com/redwood-inference/community-eval-runner/releases/tag/v0.3.0 (automated)
ian: Nice! what's the config rename? any breaking changes?
tara: Short: `eval_sets` -> `suite_configs` and `run.parallel` default changed to true. We included a one-line migration helper and backward-compat shim for two releases. No API changes to the runner binary.
tara: Migration snippet:
```bash
# scripts/migrate-eval-config.sh
jq '.suite_configs = .eval_sets | del(.eval_sets)' eval.yaml > eval.migrated.yaml
```
ci-bot: Note: CI will run compatibility checks for two releases.
mona: For maintainers: can we get an office-hours walkthrough? I can host Wed 4pm PT to demo the plugin hooks + parallel runs.
devrel: I'll add the office-hours to the community events page and record a short demo clip. Also drafting the newsletter blurb.
ian: Can we add a lint to flag `eval_sets` so folks migrate faster?
tara: Yes please — appreciate it if you open a PR. We'll add a deprecation warning in logs when old key is detected.
ci-bot: Issue created: #214 "lint: warn on legacy eval_sets key" by @ian — https://github.com/redwood-inference/community-eval-runner/issues/214
tara: Tagging maintainers @mona @ian for visibility. Soft announce in community slack now; wider social tomorrow. If you run into upgrade issues ping #devex and we'll triage. :rocket:
